:::{#thm-var-lincom}
#### Variance of a linear combination

For any vector of [random variables](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $\vX = (\dsn{X})$
and corresponding vector of constants $\va = (\dsn{a})$,
the [variance](#def-variance) of their [linear combination](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-linear-combination) is:

$$
\ba
\Var{\va \cdot \vX}
&= \Var{\sumin a_i X_i}
\\ &= \tp{\va} \Varf{\vX} \va
\\ &= \sumin \sumn{j} a_i a_j \Cov{X_i,X_j}
\ea
$$

:::

::: proof

Treat $\va$ and $\vX$ as $n \times 1$ [column vectors](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-column-vector),
so

$$
\begin{aligned}
\va \cdot \vX &= \tp{\va}\vX \\
&= \sumin a_i X_i,
\end{aligned}
$$

a [scalar](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-scalar).
By [linearity of expectation](expectation.qmd#thm-linearity-expectation), $\E{\tp{\va}\vX} = \tp{\va}\,\Expp\vX$, so:

$$
\ba
\Var{\tp{\va}\vX}
&= \E{\paren{\tp{\va}\vX - \tp{\va}\Expp\vX}^2}
&& \text{(definition of variance)} \\
&= \E{\paren{\tp{\va}\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}}^2}
&& \text{(factor out } \tp{\va} \text{)} \\
&= \E{\tp{\va}\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}\tp{\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}}\va}
&& \text{(a scalar equals its transpose, so } s^2 = s\,\tp{s} \text{)} \\
&= \tp{\va}\,\Expf{\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}\tp{\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}}}\,\va
&& \text{(linearity of expectation, element-wise)} \\
&= \tp{\va} \Varf{\vX} \va
&& \text{(variance of a random vector)} \\
&= \sumin \sumn{j} a_i a_j \Cov{X_i,X_j}
&& \text{(expand the quadratic form, using the elements of } \Varf{\vX} \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
